records.rule: Pin script file bytes as well as interpreter, and include any explicit known local dependency via --pin-file; the rest of the transitive dependency graph is not authenticated.

records.trigger: Pinned input changes between review and execution
records.rule: Reject and require a new preview/new immutable job; do not automatically refresh approval to new file bytes.
Resolve the named machine-local search scope and fail on an unknown scope; do not scan arbitrary mounts.
Treat token as approval workflow guard, not proof of an independent human approver.
Preserve child rc and exception outcome as separate evidence; no background daemon.

records.trigger: Git remote uses SSH host alias or ED209 remote helper
records.rule: Preserve configured SSH authority; never rewrite project-specific deploy-key alias to force access.

records.trigger: Agent reports package current or accepted
records.rule: Verify Autobuild receipt and native full qualification; a ready marker alone is not acceptance.
